fault: suppress ESP-NOW application ACK on the passive receiver while leaving Wi-Fi and UDP active

excluded_diagnostic_attempts.reason: sender switched ESP-NOW to UDP at 19:27:28 before the controlled ACK fault at 19:27:47; recovery was not completed before re-preparation
sender switched ESP-NOW to UDP at 19:29:33 without a controlled ACK fault; link recovered automatically at 19:34:08

pilot with 90 percent recovery threshold: controlled fallback succeeded at 19:41:43, but recovery probes produced 148/200 ACKs (74 percent) and never reached three consecutive 90-percent windows by 19:45:08

controlled run with 80 percent recovery threshold was interrupted by an ESP32 watchdog reset at 19:54:56 followed by an invalid-header boot loop; two qualifying recovery windows had already accumulated before the reset

automatic fallback occurred at 16:59:25 before the controlled fault; after the real fault, recovery occurred at 17:00:55, relapsed at 17:01:05, and recovered stably at 17:01:20, showing that startup and post-recovery stabilization are required

500 ms baseline produced repeated 0-30 percent ESP-NOW ACK windows and automatic transitions without a controlled fault; subsequent 470 ms calibration produced 427/427 ACKs across 40 windows with no transitions

470 ms controlled fallback succeeded, but independent 470 ms UDP and 1000 ms ESP-NOW recovery schedules drifted into the same radio slots; after ACK restoration recovery delivered 75/135 ACKs (55.6 percent), UDP delivered 255/288 ACKs (88.5 percent), and the longest qualifying recovery streak was two windows

235 ms recovery guard was insufficient for ESP8266: after ACK restoration ESP-NOW recovery delivered 154/305 ACKs (50.5 percent), UDP delivered 582/613 ACKs (94.9 percent), and the longest qualifying recovery streak was one window

strictly alternating 470 ms radio slots produced a correct fallback but phase-dependent recovery: after ACK restoration ESP-NOW delivered 46/234 ACKs (19.7 percent) while UDP delivered 225/234 ACKs (96.2 percent); recovery eventually occurred after 224.2 seconds, exceeding the 30-second acceptance limit and motivating explicit Wi-Fi power-save disablement

otherwise successful no-sleep attempt excluded because ACK suppression began only 20.260 seconds after preparation instead of the prescribed 30 seconds; three stabilization windows completed but only one ordinary baseline window was observed before fault injection

configuration_revision.rationale: with five recovery probes per window, 90 percent requires 5/5; 80 percent accepts 4/5 while remaining above the 70 percent fallback boundary and still requiring three consecutive good windows

probe_calibration.rationale: 470 ms avoids the repeatable low-ACK phase observed at 500 ms while preserving approximately ten probes per five-second window

recovery_scheduling_revision.strategy: alternate UDP and ESP-NOW recovery transmissions in separate 470 ms radio slots
recovery_scheduling_revision.rationale: the half-interval guard still produced only 50.5 percent recovery ACK success on ESP8266; a full slot isolates both the transmission and application ACK of each transport

wifi_power_save_revision.rationale: the full-slot diagnostic remained in a low ESP-NOW ACK phase for 224.2 seconds before three qualifying windows; keeping the shared Wi-Fi radio awake removes DTIM/modem-sleep phase as an uncontrolled variable
